prompt: How do I use color categories in Outlook?
completion:
## Quick‑Start Guide: Using Color Categories in Outlook

> **What are Color Categories?**  
> • A built‑in way to tag mail, calendar items, tasks, contacts, etc., with a **name** and a **color**.  
> • They are stored in your mailbox (Exchange/Office 365) so they sync across devices.  
> • You can **filter**, **group**, **sort**, and **search** by category, making it a powerful organizer.

Below is a step‑by‑step walkthrough for the most common Outlook environments (Windows, Mac, Outlook Web, and mobile).  Pick the section that matches your setup.

---

## 1. Outlook for Windows (2016, 2019, 2021, Microsoft 365)

| Action | Where to find it | How to do it |
|--------|------------------|--------------|
| **See all categories** | **Home** → **Tags** → **Categorize** → **All Categories…** | 1. Click **All Categories…** 2. You’ll see a list of *Name*, *Color*, and *Shortcut* (hotkey) columns |
| **Create a new category** | Same “All Categories” dialog | 1. Click **New…** 2. Pick a name, a color, and an optional shortcut key 3. Click **OK** |
| **Rename / change color of a category** | “All Categories” dialog | 1. Select the category 2. Click **Rename** or **Color** to pick a new color 3. Click **OK** |
| **Delete a category** | “All Categories” dialog | 1. Select → **Delete** → **OK** |
| **Assign a category to an item** | Right‑click item → **Categorize** or use the ribbon | 1. Right‑click → **Categorize** → pick one or more categories 2. Or, while the item is open, click **Categorize** on the ribbon and choose  |
| **Assign multiple categories** | Same as above | 1. Hold **Ctrl** (or **Cmd** on Mac) while clicking categories in the menu |
| **View items by category** | View options | 1. **View** tab → **View Settings** → **Group By…** → choose **Categories** | 2. Or use **Filter** → **More Choices** → **Categories** |
| **Sort by category** | Same **View Settings** → **Sort** | 3. Choose **Categories** in the sort order |
| **Create a search folder for a category** | **Folder** → **New Search Folder** → **Custom** | 1. Tick “Categories” and choose your color/category |
| **Automatic categorization (Rules)** | **Home** → **Rules** → **Manage Rules & Alerts** → **New Rule…** | 1. Start from blank → “Apply rule on messages I receive” → Set conditions → In the “Step 2” choose “assign it to the category…” → Pick a category |
| **Conditional formatting (highlight by category)** | **View** → **View Settings** → **Conditional Formatting** | 1. Add a rule → Set color → In “Condition” → **Categories** → choose |
| **Shortcut keys** | After assigning a shortcut in “All Categories” | 1. When an item is selected, press the shortcut (e.g., **Ctrl+Shift+1**) to toggle that category |

---

## 2. Outlook for Mac (macOS 13+, 2021, Microsoft 365)

| Action | Where to find it | How to do it |
|--------|------------------|--------------|
| **All categories** | **Organize** tab → **Categories** → **Manage…** | 1. Click **Manage…** |
| **Create / rename / delete** | Same **Manage Categories** window | 1. **Add…** to create, **Rename** button to rename, **Delete** to remove |
| **Assign a category** | **Organize** tab → **Categories** → check the color box | 1. While an email or appointment is open, click the colored square (or the category list) and tick the desired categories |
| **Multiple categories** | Same checkboxes | 1. Hold **Command** while clicking additional colors |
| **View by category** | **Organize** → **Group by** → **Categories** | 1. Choose **Categories** to group |
| **Search folder** | **Organize** → **Search** → **New Search Folder** | 1. Choose “All Mail” → **Refine** → **Categories** → pick |
| **Rules** | **Tools** → **Rules** | 1. Add a rule → Action → **Assign to category** |
| **Color shortcuts** | Not available on Mac (as of 2024) | 1. No keyboard shortcut, use the category button |

---

## 3. Outlook on the Web (OWA)

| Action | Where to find it | How to do it |
|--------|------------------|--------------|
| **All categories** | **More actions** (three dots) → **Categorize** → **All categories…** | 1. Click **All categories…** |
| **Create / rename / delete** | Same dialog | 1. Click **+ New category** or choose an existing one → **Edit** or **Delete** |
| **Assign a category** | In an email (open or preview) → **Categorize** button (tag icon) → choose | 1. Hover → click **Categorize** → pick |
| **Multiple categories** | Same | 1. Click **Add** next to each category; you can choose several |
| **Filter / sort by category** | **Filter** → **Categories** | 1. Use the filter bar to show only a category |
| **Search by category** | In the search box → type `category:"Red Category"` | 1. Use the `category:` search operator |
| **Rules** | **Settings** (gear) → **View all Outlook settings** → **Mail** → **Rules** | 1. Add rule → **Categorize** → choose |
| **Conditional formatting** | Not directly available in OWA (requires desktop client) | 1. Use the mobile app for quick toggling |

---

## 4. Outlook Mobile (iOS/Android)

- **Assign a category**: Open an email → tap **…** → **Categorize** → pick color.  
- **Create/Manage categories**: Only from desktop or web.  
- **Filter/Search by category**: Use the search bar with `category:` or use the filter UI.  
- **Shortcut keys**: None.  
- **Limitations**: No rules or conditional formatting on mobile.

---

## 5. Advanced Tips & Tricks

| Tip | How |
|-----|-----|
| **Use a naming convention** | Example: `🏠 Home`, `💼 Work`, `❗ Urgent`. Makes search easier. |
| **Create search folders for high‑priority categories** | Keeps all “Urgent” emails in one folder for quick access. |
| **Keyboard shortcuts (Windows)** | Ctrl+Shift+1 … Ctrl+Shift+9 to toggle categories 1–9. |
| **Apply a category via Quick Steps** | **Home** → **Quick Steps** → **New** → choose “Assign Category” action. |
| **Automate with Power Automate** | Create a flow that receives an email → parse subject → set category. |
| **Export/Import categories** | Not directly available; you can script via PowerShell or VBA to copy categories between mailboxes. |
| **Conditional formatting** | Color rows by category to quickly spot them in the inbox. |
| **Use categories on calendar** | In a meeting, click the **Categorize** button → choose color. |
| **Filter by category in the calendar** | **View** → **View Settings** → **Filter** → **Categories**. |

---

## 6. Common Issues & Fixes

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| **Category colors not showing** | Ensure you’re using a modern Outlook version; older 2013 versions use “Flags” instead of “Categories.” |
| **Categories lost after migration** | Verify that categories were stored in the mailbox (Exchange/Office 365). If moved to a local PST, categories may disappear. |
| **Shortcuts not working** | Some keyboards need **Fn** + **Ctrl** + **Shift** + number. |
| **Duplicate categories** | Open “All Categories” and delete or rename duplicates. |
| **Categories not syncing** | Make sure you’re connected to the same Exchange/Office 365 account on all devices. |

---

## Quick Cheat Sheet (Windows)

| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| `Ctrl+Shift+1-9` | Toggle category 1–9 |
| `Alt+G` | Group by categories |
| `Ctrl+Shift+K` | Apply a quick step (if configured) |
| `Alt+Shift+T` | Assign a color-coded flag (different from category) |

---

### Bottom Line

Color categories give you a flexible, cross‑device way to tag and organize every type of Outlook item.  Once you get the hang of assigning and filtering by categories, your inbox and calendar will look cleaner and you’ll be able to locate any item in a snap.  Happy categorizing!
